question: Should Discord subagent progress ship with this seven-setting public configuration and a separate lifecycle reaction tracker, or should it be integrated with the existing status-reaction owner or narrowed to typing-only liveness?
rationale: The remaining collision can be fixed mechanically, but automation cannot choose the permanent Discord UX, configuration footprint, or plugin/channel lifecycle contract.

options.title: Integrate Reaction Ownership
options.body: Keep the feature but route count and failure states through one source-message reaction owner and retain only configuration with a demonstrated operator need.

options.title: Approve Separate Tracker
options.body: Keep the parallel tracker after every ack/status collision rule and compatibility expectation is documented and tested.

options.title: Narrow To Typing
options.body: Ship typing keepalive first and defer reactions and their configuration surface to a smaller follow-up.

recommendation.title: Integrate Reaction Ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the feature but route count and failure states through one source-message reaction owner and retain only configuration with a demonstrated operator need.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to Discord ack reactions, subagent lifecycle refactors, and the relevant plugin/channel architecture boundary.
